Module initialized and working. Structure:

- `go.mod` — module `example.com/textconv`, depends on `golang.org/x/text v0.42.0`
- `textconv.go` — library: `Decode`, `Encode`, `Convert`, `Normalize` (+ `Encodings`)
- `textconv_test.go` — round-trip, encoding, and normalization tests
- `cmd/textconv/main.go` — CLI with `convert`, `normalize`, and `encodings` commands

Supported encodings include UTF-8/16, Windows-1252, ISO-8859-*, KOI8-R, Shift_JIS, EUC-JP/KR, GBK/GB18030, and Big5; normalization covers NFC/NFD/NFKC/NFKD. Verified with `go vet`, `go test ./...`, and a smoke run.

Note: I used the placeholder module path `example.com/textconv`. If you have a real repo path (e.g. `github.com/you/textconv`), tell me and I'll update it.
